purpose: Test one isolated post-latch mechanism: whether holding only the seven arm commands at exact zero until an actor-visible plus public force-counter-sidecar 15-frame stable-grasp verification reduces Candidate39's downstream unlatched-lift failures without suppressing true 20 cm transport. The frozen LIFT hand policy, Candidate39 pre-latch fixed residual, SEARCH policy, reward, task physics, and tactile shield remain unchanged.

development_only.allowed_claim_if_all_gates_pass: The verified-arm handoff is eligible for a separately preregistered formal A/B screen; Candidate40 is not yet accepted or deployable.
development_only.allowed_claim_if_any_gate_fails: Reject this isolated arm-handoff mechanism on these settings. A later sticky-hand experiment must be a new candidate and must not reuse these development outcomes as acceptance evidence.
forbidden_claims: generalization outside the registered development seeds
proof that the frozen LIFT hand command is optimal

sealed_forensics.interpretation: The fixed residual changes grasp acquisition posture, but every observed triggered U5 occurred only after residual retirement and immediate common frozen-LIFT routing. Existing artifacts cannot distinguish early arm acceleration from hand-command mismatch, so Candidate40 changes only live arm-authority timing and measures that supervisor's total effect.

older_context_only_evidence.warning: These seed-187 close-start results used older checkpoints and are not acceptance evidence for Candidate40.
older_context_only_evidence.interpretation: Freezing the hand is not bundled into Candidate40 because the older ablation reduced throughput and would confound attribution.

common_candidate39_route.pre_latch_close: Every slot, irrespective of Candidate40 assignment, receives the exact sealed Candidate39 fixed_z hand14 residual during the same 32-action pre-latch window. There is no zero-residual Candidate39 control in this experiment.
common_candidate39_route.residual_retirement: The first public latch anywhere in the episode permanently retires Candidate39's residual, including a SEARCH-side latch and all later latch loss and regrasp.
common_candidate39_route.unlatched_after_retirement: Exact deterministic V6 CLOSE with arm7 exactly zero and no residual.
common_candidate39_route.latched_hand: Exact frozen-LIFT hand14 on every option-active public-latched action in both groups.
common_candidate39_route.latched_control_arm: Exact frozen-LIFT arm7 immediately on every option-active public-latched action.
common_candidate39_route.tactile_shield: The unchanged environment tactile shield remains final authority over actions and joint targets in both groups.

candidate40_intervention_contract.name: public_verified_live_arm_handoff_v1
candidate40_intervention_contract.only_randomized_difference: On treatment slots only and only after the first option-active latch-visible decision, replace the exact Candidate39 baseline arm7 with zeros unless the public verifier authorizes arm motion; never change hand14 or any SEARCH routing.

public_force_counter_sidecar.routing_prohibition: Raw transition force, true clearance, terminal truth, and any evaluator-only geometry may be recorded but must never enter the supervisor action decision.

candidate40_intervention_contract.first_eligible_decision: The first episode-active pre-action row with option_active==1 and obs[106]==1. Its truth is determined before the Candidate40 action, so it defines the pre-treatment causal domain even if the latch originally arose during SEARCH. All earlier rows execute exact Candidate39, and SEARCH rows always remain exact SEARCH.
candidate40_intervention_contract.stable_current: option_active and obs[106]==1 and min(obs[103],obs[104])>=0.35 and obs[104]>=0.50 and max(obs[97:102])<=float32(tanh(30/5)) and both public force-counter progress values equal zero

row_state_machine.stable_count_before: The prior row's stable_count_after, initialized to zero and clamped to [0,15].
row_state_machine.treatment_arm7: Exact Candidate39 baseline arm7 if arm_enabled_this_action, otherwise zeros7; this overlay is applied only after activation and never changes SEARCH.
row_state_machine.control_arm7: Exact Candidate39 baseline arm7 on every row; the shadow verifier never edits control.
row_state_machine.hand14: Exact Candidate39 baseline hand14 for both assignments on every row.
row_state_machine.stable_count_after: min(15, stable_count_before+1) if stable_current, otherwise zero.

candidate40_intervention_contract.first_latch_clock: Record the first public-latch transition separately from first_eligible_decision. Neither clock may be inferred from terminal physical-grasp telemetry.
candidate40_intervention_contract.enable_clock: The first eligible stable row has stable_count_before=0 and executes arm7=0. The fifteenth consecutive stable row has stable_count_before=14, executes arm7=0, and sets stable_count_after=15. Only the next still-stable row may execute exact Candidate39 arm7.
candidate40_intervention_contract.live_relock: After enablement, any latch loss, wrap-quality failure, hold-quality failure, or public force-limit failure zeros arm7 on that same action and resets the counter. A new sequence of 15 held-arm stable observations is required before re-enable.
candidate40_intervention_contract.control: Exact common Candidate39 route with immediate frozen-LIFT arm7; verifier state is computed counterfactually for telemetry but never edits control actions.
candidate40_intervention_contract.treatment_hand_invariance: Treatment hand14 must be bit-exact to the common Candidate39 route on every active action, including VERIFY, released LIFT, relock, and regrasp.
candidate40_intervention_contract.pre_release_launch_event: For a treatment-eligible episode, either true clearance exceeding 0.015 m or true clearance increasing by at least 0.015 m above its first-eligible-decision clearance before its first arm-enabled action is a zero-tolerance development safety failure. This evaluator-only label never changes routing or environment termination semantics.
candidate40_intervention_contract.artifact_trace_horizon: first eligible decision through authoritative terminal or timeout

assignment.ranking: Sort env_slot by SHA256 digest bytes with env_slot as deterministic tie-breaker.
assignment.replicate_a: The first 32 ranked slots are verified-arm treatment; the remaining 32 are immediate-arm control.
assignment.replicate_b: Bit-exact complement of replicate a, without reranking.
assignment.per_seed_pairing: Each stable env_slot is observed once under verified-arm treatment and once under immediate-arm control across complementary replicates.

estimands.contrast: verified-arm treatment minus immediate-arm Candidate39 control
estimands.eligibility_domain: First episodes that reach the first episode-active pre-action decision with option_active==1 and obs[106]==1. Eligibility is measured before the first Candidate40-dependent action. All preceding actions, including any SEARCH-side latch history, are exact common Candidate39.
estimands.seed_weighting: Equal arithmetic mean of seed-335 and seed-336 estimates.

primary.name: conditional_stable_transport_restricted_mean_delta
primary.per_transition_value: x_h = I(public_latch and grasp_quality>=0.35 and hold_quality>=0.50 and max_force<=30N) * clip(true_mesh_clearance/0.20, 0, 1)
primary.stable_value: g_h is the minimum x over the current and preceding 14 transitions; g_h=0 until 15 post-latch transitions exist
primary.episode_outcome: mean(g_0...g_127); after authoritative strict success, unobserved suffix values are one, while failure, drop, unsafe, timeout, or ordinary horizon exhaustion contributes no absorbing credit
primary.estimator: Within each seed, Horvitz-Thompson treatment minus control on the pre-treatment eligibility domain using known propensity 0.5; then equal-weight the two seed estimates.
primary.reason: This rewards early sustained true transport, gives no credit to a fling or a sub-15-frame height spike, and makes holding forever without lifting score near zero.

implementation_clarifications_before_sim.trace_scope: Record every option-active pre-eligibility action plus the unique first-latch witness, then every first-eligible-through-terminal action. The trigger action observation may therefore reside in either table and must be unique.
implementation_clarifications_before_sim.trigger_contract: The q0.30/h4 trigger cannot occur before episode action 3, and trigger_score is recomputed as min(thumb proximity, second-largest non-thumb proximity) from the trigger action's pre-action observation.
implementation_clarifications_before_sim.stable_transport_indexing: The restricted mean uses eligible ages 0..127. The stable-held-5cm-by-action96 event inspects ages 0..95 and is true when any 15-action rolling minimum g_h is at least 0.25.
implementation_clarifications_before_sim.authoritative_reset: Every supervisor call requires the prior transition's authoritative reset mask; all activation, verification, enable, and relock memory is cleared before any action in a reset slot.
implementation_clarifications_before_sim.smoke_coverage: The smoke must contain at least one treatment-eligible trace and pass every registered algebra, safety, and validator check. Natural verification completion, arm enablement, relock, or re-enable occurrence is not an additional outcome-dependent smoke gate; those semantics are covered structurally and by simulation-free tests.
implementation_clarifications_before_sim.source_authority: Before AppLauncher, the complete 104-entry runtime source manifest is checked against the implementation commit, the fixed FlashSAC submodule commit, strict Git-LFS oid/size receipts, generated-USD expected hashes, and the separately sealed plan. All eight runtime assets are checked before, during, and after collection.

candidate39_to_candidate40_route_and_evi.deselection_reason: The legacy Candidate39 test expects its canonical output path to be absent; that output is already immutably sealed and was not removed or overwritten.

decision_rule.if_all_gates_pass: Seal the four artifacts and development report, then write and commit a separate formal-acceptance plan before touching seeds 337-339. Development pass alone does not accept Candidate40.
decision_rule.if_any_gate_fails: Reject Candidate40 on the registered settings and do not run seeds 337-339. Do not reinterpret thresholds or outcomes. Diagnose the post-latch traces before proposing a separately named hand-controller candidate.
